title: Hierarchical Latent Structure Learning through Online Inference
abstract: arXiv:2603.19139v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Learning systems must balance generalization across experiences with discrimination of task-relevant details. Effective learning therefore requires representations that support both. Online latent-cause models support incremental inference but assume flat partitions, whereas hierarchical Bayesian models capture multilevel structure but typically require offline inference. We introduce the \textbf{Hierarchical Online Learning of Multiscale Experience Structure (HOLMES) model}, a computational framework for hierarchical latent structure learning through online inference. HOLMES combines a variation on the nested Chinese Restaurant Process prior with sequential Monte Carlo inference to perform tractable trial-by-trial inference over hierarchical latent representations without explicit supervision over the latent structure. In simulations, HOLMES matched the predictive performance of flat models while learning more compact representation

translated_title: 基于在线推断的层级潜在结构学习
translated_abstract: 学习系统必须在跨经验的泛化能力与对任务相关细节的辨别能力之间取得平衡。因此，有效的学习需要能够同时支持两者的表征。在线潜在原因模型支持增量式推断，但假设的是平坦的划分结构；而层级贝叶斯模型能够捕捉多层级结构，但通常需要进行离线推断。我们提出了HOLMES模型（多尺度经验结构的层级在线学习，Hierarchical Online Learning of Multiscale Experience Structure），这是一个通过在线推断实现层级潜在结构学习的计算框架。HOLMES将嵌套中餐馆过程先验的一个变体与序贯蒙特卡洛推断相结合，在无需对潜在结构进行显式监督的情况下，实现对层级潜在表征的可处理的逐试验推断。在模拟实验中，HOLMES在预测性能上与平坦模型相当，同时学习到了更紧凑的表征。
tldr: 该论文提出HOLMES计算框架，通过结合嵌套中餐馆过程先验的变体与序贯蒙特卡洛推断，首次实现了无需显式监督、可逐试验在线进行层级潜在结构学习的推断方法，并在保持平坦模型预测性能的同时获得更紧凑的表征。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HOLMES, a computational framework that combines a variation of the nested Chinese Restaurant Process prior with sequential Monte Carlo inference to enable tractable trial-by-trial online learning of hierarchical latent structure without explicit supervision, matching flat models' predictive performance while learning more compact representations.
